{{Quote|Welcome! I am Lt. Jarad Gastin. Are you here to donate to the Alliance for its war on the tyrannical Empire?|Lieutenant Jarad Gastin, to a Rebel sympathizer|<ref name="SWG:LJG" />}}
'''Jarad Gastin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Gastin was stationed on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and operated out of a [[Anchorhead Tavern|tavern]] in the city of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]].<ref name="SWG:LJG" /> In this notorious Rebel stronghold,<ref name="GG">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Friday%20Feature:GCW%20Guide|text=Friday Feature: GCW Guide}}</ref> he collected [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] contributions from Rebel sympathizers eager to support the war effort.<ref name="SWG:LJG" /> During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Jarad Gastin received a generous donation of one million credits from an unknown [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]].<ref name="SWG:LJG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jarad Gastin was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LJG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Major Lt. Jarad Gastin was added to the game with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Game Update 9|Game Update 9]], on [[April 30]], [[2009]]. He was one of the three NPCs (along with [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Caleb Knolar]] and [[Ozzmos Roberts]]) added with the update that were used as [[:wikipedia:Gold sink|credit sinks]] to remove money from the game economy and combat inflation.<ref name="GU9">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=908618|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 9}}</ref> For paying one million credits, the player received the player title "Rebel Sympathizer."<ref name="SWG:LJG" />
